messages.author: 1e1f02e079119aa4
messages.subject: Estimates without covariates
parts:
I'd like to get site-specific abundance estimates using pcount, but
without any abundance covariates. I tried manually building a dummy
variable identity matrix and using this as the site covariates. For
one thing, it's not a very efficient way to code for this. But more
seriously, I couldn't get the model to run without a "Hessian is
singular" error message. Based on responses to another post, I also
tried giving starting values (0s), but this didn't help. Any advice?

Thanks!

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Estimates without covariates
parts:
you can fit a pcount model with constant parameters and then use the ranef() function.
andy
